resources.string: Tip
Dismiss tip
Open setting
Turn off tips
Tips while the agent works
Now and then, show a short tip about features and settings while a task runs.
Show or hide feature tips while tasks run
Quick question while the agent works? Type /btw and your question. It sees everything so far and never joins the chat.
Messages you send now are read after the agent\'s current step, so you can change course without stopping it.
Messages you send now wait until the task finishes. Switch to AH Auto to steer the agent mid-task.
Choose how often the agent asks before acting, from confirming everything to full access.
Save chat agents with their own instructions, model, tone and knowledge files, then pick one from the composer.
Turn on AH Rumble to feel tool calls and thinking as gentle haptics.
Let tasks keep running when you leave the app.
Type /plan to have the agent explore and plan first, without changing any files.
Type /cost to see what this chat has spent and how much the prompt cache saved.
Add fallback models so a busy or failing provider does not stop your task.
Add instructions every chat follows, like your preferred tone or language, in Chat options.
Replies can be read aloud automatically. Pick a voice and speed in Voice settings.
Put project rules in AGENTS.md and the agent follows them on every run.
Turn on memory so AndroidHarness remembers your preferences and decisions across chats.
Memory is on. You can review or delete what AndroidHarness remembers at any time.
Tap the thinking level in the header to trade speed for deeper reasoning.
Try Harness Glass for translucent, layered surfaces across the app.
Running low on context? Type /compact to summarize the conversation and keep going.
Set how much web research a reply does from the header, from Instant to Max research.
Turn on notifications to know when a long task finishes.
Use one model to plan and another, cheaper one to carry out the plan.
Install CodeGraph so the agent finds callers and affected code without reading every file.
Dictate with Groq Whisper for fast, accurate speech input in many languages.
Lock AndroidHarness with your fingerprint, face or device PIN.
Connect MCP servers to give the agent more tools.
Choose your web search backend: Keyless, Brave or Tavily.
Pick a color palette or build your own in Appearance.
Subagents can run on a different model, so big tasks can hand work to a cheaper one.
Run models fully offline on your phone with Local models.
Sign in to GitHub to import repositories and publish changes from the app.
Turn on Live updates to follow task progress from your lock screen and status bar.
Set a limit on tool rounds so a task cannot run forever.
Have a ChatGPT plan? Sign in with it instead of using an API key.
Turn on Show live code to watch code being written as the agent drafts it.
Turn on the repo map so the agent gets an index of your project\'s symbols.
Caveman gives shorter replies and token reports, which saves output tokens.
Pair a Telegram bot to continue chats and edit projects from Telegram.
Share project settings with your repo through harness.json.
Set up Shizuku so the agent can use elevated shell access on your device.
Install plugin bundles from the Plugins page to add skills and tools.
AndroidHarness is available in 11 languages. Change it in Language settings.
Export your chats and settings as a backup, and import them on another device.
Change the style of the working progress bar in Appearance.
You can turn these tips off any time in Settings.
